purpose: Teach: 学内/人名/右上/左上/つけれ/筐/院内/バッティング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 大学との学内連携プロジェクト、進捗、どうだ。
lines.en: How's the university partnership project progressing?
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Direct eye contact. Minimal breath. Waiting for substance, not pleasantries.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料の人名一覧、最新版に更新しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've updated the personnel list in the documentation to the latest version.
lines.style: Clear, steady delivery. Professional but not stiff. The confidence of someone who has the detail right in front of him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: グラフ、右上に注釈、入れろ。
lines.en: Add an annotation to the top-right of the graph.
lines.style: Flat instruction. No inflection. Assumes compliance. Quick breath before the next thought.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。表の左上、社名ロゴ、配置しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've placed the company logo in the top-left of the table.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact confirmation. Slightly faster pace — keeping up with the tempo Hiroshi has set. No embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 予算、もう少しつければ、新事業、加速する。
lines.en: With a bit more budget allocated, we can accelerate the new business initiative.
lines.style: Measured, strategic. A slight pause after 'budget' — the weight of resource allocation. Speaks from experience about what more money can do.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サーバ筐体の更新、計画的に、進めます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with the planned server refresh on schedule.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Tempo matching Hiroshi's. Solid, no hesitation. The reassurance of a plan already being executed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 院内研修、医療法人との合同、検討しろ。
lines.en: Look into joint in-house training with the medical corporation.
lines.style: Instruction delivered as a task assignment. Brief pause after 'training' — letting him know this matters. Expects a considered approach.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のバッティング大会、福利厚生で、開催します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll hold a company softball tournament as a staff benefit.
lines.style: Final item, warmer note entering Kenji's voice — almost small relief. Still professional, but the slight lift of wrapping up a solid meeting.
